description: Convert an OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 or Swagger 2.0 document (JSON or YAML) into a JMeter 5.6.3 .jmx test plan: servers become HTTP Request Defaults/${BASE_URL}, path parameters become User Defined Variables, request bodies are sampled from schemas, bearer/basic/apiKey security becomes ${AUTH_TOKEN}/${BASIC_AUTH}/${API_KEY}, with optional method, tag, and deprecated-operation filters.

durationSeconds.description: Test duration in seconds (0 = disabled, default: 0).

includeAssertions.description: Add HTTP 200/201/204 Response Code assertions (default: true).

input.description: OpenAPI 3.x or Swagger 2.0 document as JSON or YAML text (max 1MB).

maxOperations.description: Maximum number of operations to convert (default: 500).

methods.description: HTTP methods to include (default: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE).

parameterizeHost.description: Extract the common host into HTTP Request Defaults and ${BASE_URL} (default: true).

serverIndex.description: Zero-based index of the OpenAPI server to use (default: 0).

tags.description: Only include operations with one of these tags ("default" = untagged). Empty = all.

testPlanName.description: Name of the JMeter Test Plan.

useExampleValues.description: Substitute example/sample values into path params instead of ${var} variables (default: false).

name: convert_openapi_to_jmx
title: Convert OpenAPI / Swagger to JMeter JMX Test Plan
